learning_objective: The learner can select appropriate evaluation methods and curate evaluation data sets that reflect production scenarios, including edge cases and out-of-scope inputs.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing one evaluation set is sufficient to represent all production data slices and edge cases.
Assuming a single evaluation method can measure all criteria without needing specialized scorers or AI judges.
Thinking that specialized scorers and AI judges can succeed without unambiguous scoring rubrics and examples.
